description:
Projected resident population of every Queensland council area, 2021 then every five years to 2046, with five age bands. **Modelled estimates.**

Coverage: Queensland: 77 council areas; 2021, 2026, 2031, 2036, 2041, 2046 (figures at 30 June). Current to 2046-06-30. Full description, field list and method: `/v1/datasets/population-projections-qld`.

**Price: 5¢ per call.**

fields.description: Comma-separated subset of: total_population, aged_0_14, aged_15_24, aged_25_44, aged_45_64, aged_65_plus, total_population_low, total_population_high. Omit for all.

lga_name.description: Council (LGA) name exactly as /v1/lga/list returns it, e.g. `Lake Macquarie`.

to.description: Last period to include, same formats as `from`.

name: lga_demographics_population_projections_qld
title: LGA · Population projections (Qld)
